item.title: Average price for 500L of heating oil in Donegal surpasses €700
item.description: It’s reported on oilprices.ie that the average price for 500L in Donegal is now over €700. Today’s average has increased by €88.60 to €706.51. It marks a 41% increase since Sunday, when the average was €502.43. item.title: 50,000 more families to receive Fuel Allowance from next week
item.description: 50,000 more families will receive the Fuel Allowance payment from next week. As outlined in the Budget, the scheme is being expanded to include those in receipt of the Working Family Payment. The measure comes into effect next week and will be backdated to January, meaning families will receive up to €380 on March 12th. item.title: Donegal County Council takes charge of three east Donegal housing estates
item.description: Donegal County Council has officially taken charge of three housing estates in east Donegal. These are Dromore Park in Killygordon, Hazelwood Drive in Lifford and Ard Tomaire in Convoy. Members of the public can now contact the county council directly regarding matters such as public lighting, roads, sewage and storm drains.
